Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TROLLEY FOR GENERAL MEDICAL STORE 



11. 

o 

X 



B 
a 



1- Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for trolley used for general medical store. 

2!. Material 

2*1 Steel ru6e — As given in 2.1 of IS : 4033-1968 * General requirements for hospital furniture \ 

2.2 Angles — Mild steel. 

2.3 Castors — Conforming to IS : 4034-1968 * Specification for castors for hospital equipment '• 

3. Shape and DImensions-As shown in Fig. 1. 

3.1 A deviation of ±10 mm shall be allowed on all major dimensions. 

4. Manufacture 

4.1 Handle — The handle shall be manufactured from steel tube bent and welded as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.2 Frame — Shall be made from mild steel angles. The wire mesh, brackets for rubber and castor 
wheels shall be tack welded to the frame. Mild steel sheet in one piece shall be of 1'25 mm thick- 
mess and shall also be welded to the frame. When required by the purchaser, the wire netting shall 
Ihave an arrangement on one side to open out through hinges and hooks. 

J5. Workmanship 

5.1 All surfaces shall be well finished and smooth. 

5.2 All welded joints shall have welds fully penetrating and shall be well finished. 

5.3 All edges shall be rounded off. 

6. Finish — As specified in 5 of IS ; 4033-1668. 

7. Tests 

7.1 Adhesion Test— Carry out the test as prescribed in 6.1.1 of IS : 4033-1968. 

7.2 Performance Test— Carry out the test as prescribed in 6.1.2 of IS : 4033-1968. However, the 
performance shall be determined by putting a mass of 150 kg for larger and 100 kg for smaller siz€ 
trolleys equally distributed at each corner. 

8. Marking — The trolley shall have a name plate or label fixed to it showing the manufacturer? 
name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 

5fc.8.1 ISl Cerlification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

9. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 



Adopted 30 April 1979
